identity.tagline: A living website. Tell it what to become.

seo.title: Jordan Bennett
seo.description: A personal site that can be redesigned in conversation. Public to the world, shaped in a private studio.

sections.heading: Jordan Bennett
sections.subheading: This page is live. Change the colors, the words, the whole business — the public site updates the moment you ask.

sections.heading: What this space can hold
sections.subheading: Ask the studio to turn this into a bakery, a portfolio, a restaurant, or anything else.

items.title: A public homepage
items.body: Anyone can visit this URL. There is no login on the public site — only the finished pages.

items.title: A locked studio
items.body: Only you can open /studio. That is where you talk to the designer and publish instantly.

items.title: Live customizations
items.body: Say “make it a coffee shop with ocean colors.” The live site becomes that, right away.

sections.heading: Start with a sentence. Keep going from there.
sections.body: Replace this with your story. Name the business. Add photos, pricing, testimonials, a contact section — or wipe it and begin again. The public site always shows the latest version.

sections.heading: Say hello
sections.body: Add your email, phone, or city in the studio and this block will fill itself in.

sections.note: Built in a private studio. Shown to everyone else.
